physical_gpu_detected: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4070 Laptop GPU, 8188 MiB
decision: A GPU is physically present but the installed torch is the CPU-only build: the CUDA build of torch plus its NVIDIA libraries needs roughly 4-5 GB, which would consume most of the 6 GB budget. Everything is therefore designed for CPU (frozen backbone + linear probe); end-to-end fine-tuning is skipped.
